display.purpose: Team names on the active match screen, tournament titles, projected bracket champions. The tale-of-the-tape moment. Never on body.

headline.purpose: Page titles, group names, KO round labels.

title.purpose: Card titles, match-list rows, modal headings.

body.purpose: Admin descriptions, microcopy, public-surface body content. Cap line length at 65 to 75ch.

label.purpose: Status badges, table headers, metadata, corner labels. Uppercase, letter-spaced.

numeric.purpose: Timer, scores, points, cup counts, ranks. Tabular figures with slashed zero (ss01); always mono.

shadows.purpose: Trophy-gold ambient glow plus 1px gold inset ring on actively-running match containers and live KO bracket nodes. The only ambient shadow in the system.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Two-layer focus ring on form inputs. Deep-gold outer ring against stage-bg inner ring; readable on every surface.

motion.name: stage-pulse
motion.purpose: Badge-active leading-dot pulse and live-marker dot. Scale 1 to 1.6, opacity 1 to 0.5, alternates.

motion.name: stage-overtime
motion.purpose: Timer-overtime opacity pulse (1 to 0.55). Signals the timer has crossed zero.

motion.name: live-glow-transition
motion.purpose: KO match background transition when a node becomes live (status change response).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Cream-on-stage inversion. Spiel starten, Ergebnis speichern, Zum Turnier.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; min-height: 3.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: oklch(96% 0.011 80); color: oklch(11% 0.011 80); font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.99); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(11% 0.011 80), 0 0 0 4px oklch(72% 0.180 75); }

components.name: Danger Button (Modal Trigger)
components.description: Used only for Runde beenden. Opens a Flux confirmation modal rather than firing the destructive action directly.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 1.25rem; border: 1px solid oklch(64% 0.210 28); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: oklch(30% 0.080 28); color: oklch(64% 0.210 28); font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: oklch(22% 0.015 80); } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: scale(0.99); }

components.name: Score Control (+/-)
components.description: Signature primitive. Oversized +/- triad for sticky-finger referee scoring. 56px tap targets, font-numeric input, gold focus ring.
components.css: .ds-score-control { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; } .ds-score-btn { height: 3.5rem; width: 3.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: oklch(11% 0.011 80); color: oklch(96% 0.011 80); font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out, transform 100ms ease-out; } .ds-score-btn:hover { background: oklch(22% 0.015 80); } .ds-score-btn:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-score-input { height: 3.5rem; width: 5rem; padding: 0; border: 1px solid oklch(32% 0.017 80); border-radius: 0.375rem; background: oklch(11% 0.011 80); color: oklch(96% 0.011 80); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono Variable', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; text-align: center; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-feature-settings: 'tnum' 1, 'zero' 1, 'ss01' 1; } .ds-score-input:focus { outline: 0; border-color: oklch(48% 0.020 80); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(11% 0.011 80), 0 0 0 4px oklch(72% 0.180 75); }

components.name: Status Badge (Active)
components.description: Pill-shaped uppercase label with a pulsing leading dot. The .badge-active variant for live matches.
components.css: @keyframes ds-stage-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } 50% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(1.6); } } .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge::before { content: ''; display: inline-block; width: 0.375rem; height: 0.375rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; } .ds-badge-active { color: oklch(72% 0.180 150); background: oklch(32% 0.075 150); } .ds-badge-active::before { animation: ds-stage-pulse 1.4s ease-out infinite; }

components.name: Rank Chip (Podium)
components.description: 2rem square with centered tabular-mono digit. Rank 1 takes trophy gold; ranks 2 and 3 a desaturated warm silver and bronze. The podium variants invert to dark text on saturated background.
components.css: .ds-rank { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 2rem; height: 2rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono Variable', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; background: oklch(22% 0.015 80); color: oklch(78% 0.022 80); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-rank-1 { background: oklch(82% 0.160 78); color: oklch(11% 0.011 80); } .ds-rank-2 { background: oklch(72% 0.020 80); color: oklch(11% 0.011 80); } .ds-rank-3 { background: oklch(60% 0.110 50); color: oklch(96% 0.011 80); }

components.name: Two-Corner Face-Off
components.description: Signature framing for every match surface: home (red corner) left, away (blue corner) right, soft radial washes meeting at a 1px gradient divider, all over stage-surface.
components.html:
Red CornerTeam Bierherz
Blue CornerTeam NullPointer
components.css: .ds-faceoff { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 2rem; padding: 2rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 0% 50%, color-mix(in oklch, oklch(30% 0.080 26) 70%, transparent) 0%, transparent 60%), radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 100% 50%, color-mix(in oklch, oklch(30% 0.075 240) 70%, transparent) 0%, transparent 60%), oklch(16% 0.013 80); } .ds-faceoff-side { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-faceoff-away { text-align: right; } .ds-faceoff-label { font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-label-red { color: oklch(72% 0.210 28); } .ds-label-blue { color: oklch(72% 0.170 240); } .ds-faceoff-team { font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.025em; line-height: 0.95; font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 5vw, 2.5rem); color: oklch(96% 0.011 80); } .ds-faceoff-divider { width: 1px; align-self: stretch; background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0%, oklch(48% 0.020 80) 15%, oklch(48% 0.020 80) 85%, transparent 100%); }

narrative.overview: pongtable sits at the intersection of three traditions. The heavyweight industrial typography of craft-brewery merch (BrewDog, Mikkeller, Stone). The HUD energy of esports broadcast overlays (LoL Worlds, Valorant Champions). The two-corner face-off drama of a UFC fight-night card. The result is an interface that takes beerpong as seriously as Premier League, and reads as a tournament instead of a SaaS dashboard. Every neutral is warm-tinted on hue 80 so the canvas evokes a taproom under low light, not a sterile workspace. The referee-on-a-phone is the primary surface, but the design language is calibrated to the projected bracket. The system runs dark by default and ships a light counterpart for projector-on-a-bright-wall scenarios.
keyCharacteristics: Four-role committed palette: red corner, blue corner, trophy gold, warm-tinted stage neutrals on hue 80.
Single-family typography (Inter Variable for sans, JetBrains Mono Variable for numerics), with the broadcast energy living in scale and weight rather than decoration.
Flat-by-default surfaces. Depth is tonal step, not shadow.
Two-corner framing on every match surface; home and away are visually opposed and equal.
Mobile-first referee surface; desktop-dense admin surface; broadcast-first public surface.
Responsive motion only: timer pulse, badge dot, gold glow on live elements. No choreographed entrances.

rules.name: The Two-Corner Rule
rules.body: Red Corner and Blue Corner carry equal visual weight on every match screen. Never adjust saturation, size, or position to favor one side. The face-off is symmetric or it is broken.

rules.name: The Gold-For-Glory Rule
rules.body: Trophy Gold is reserved. Live-match glow, active timer warning, podium 1 chip, champion banner, KO-bracket live trim. Never on default buttons. If gold is showing, something is being won.

rules.name: The Tinted-Black Rule
rules.body: No pure black, no pure white. Every neutral carries a small warm chroma on hue 80 so the canvas reads taproom-warm rather than sterile.

rules.name: The OKLCH-Only Rule
rules.body: All color tokens are authored in OKLCH. Chroma is reduced as lightness approaches the extremes.

rules.name: The Tabular-Numeric Rule
rules.body: Every number is set in font-numeric (JetBrains Mono Variable, tabular figures, ss01). Sans numerics are prohibited; digit reflow during live update is unacceptable on the broadcast surface.

rules.name: The Scale-Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Minimum 1.25x step between adjacent hierarchy levels. Display headlines clamp up to 5.5rem on the public surface and 9rem on the live timer.

rules.name: The Single-Family Rule
rules.body: No display/body font pairing. Inter Variable carries every text role; numerics step out to JetBrains Mono. Two faces in the system, no more.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards and surfaces are flat at rest. Depth is tonal step, not shadow. Shadows are a state response (live, focus), not a baseline.

rules.name: The Gold-Glow Rule
rules.body: The only ambient shadow in the system is the trophy-gold live-match glow. Other colors do not earn glow; the rarity is what makes the live match read as alive.

dos: Do commit to the four-role palette. Red Corner and Blue Corner stay symmetric; Trophy Gold stays reserved; warm-tinted near-black is the canvas.
Do set every number in font-numeric (JetBrains Mono Variable, tabular figures, ss01). Timers, scores, ranks, points, cups. Sans numerics for numbers are prohibited.
Do make tap targets oversized on referee scoring: +/- at 3.5rem (56px) on entry surfaces, primary action buttons at 3rem (48px) minimum.
Do design the projected bracket and leaderboard for 5+ meter readability first. Calibrate referee and admin surfaces down from that bar.
Do use font-display (weight 800, letter-spacing -0.025em, line-height 0.95) on team names and active-match surfaces.
Do route motion to state changes: timer color shift, badge dot pulse, live-glow ramp, status transitions.
Do author every color in OKLCH. Reduce chroma toward the lightness extremes.
Do keep dark as the default. Light is the projector-on-a-bright-wall scheme; the broadcast canvas is the home.
donts: Don't build a generic SaaS dashboard. No navy sidebar, no three-stat-cards along the top, no indigo accents.
Don't evoke a corporate sports betting site. No DraftKings or FanDuel green-and-gold-on-black, no casino-adjacent CTAs.
Don't introduce frat-house clipart. No cartoon beer mugs, no red Solo cups as decoration, no comic-sans energy.
Don't Linear-clean the system. Restraint and whitespace are not the answer; the personality is loud, communal, alive.
Don't use pure black or pure white. Tint every neutral toward hue 80 with chroma 0.011 to 0.024.
Don't put Trophy Gold on a default button. The rarity is the point.
Don't animate CSS layout properties. Pulse and ripple with transform and opacity only.
Don't introduce a fifth color role. The four roles carry the system.
Don't use side-stripe borders as a colored accent on cards, list items, or alerts.
Don't stack nested cards. If a section needs containment, use a tonal step.
Don't choreograph entrance animations or scroll-driven sequences. Motion is responsive only.
Don't introduce a display font for body, labels, or buttons. Inter Variable carries every sans role.
Don't show modals as a first thought. The system has exactly one confirmation modal (end-of-round).
